items.note: For the bit network the plan states (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch and follows the paper's proof exactly: net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c; central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2 with side cancellation; forward/inverse/forward composition (741-765). But the lemma covers both constructions. The complex scalar network (Z[i,1/2], even-intersection neighbours, central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2, C_*) and the wire counts W_b, W_c (767-782) are never given, so the complex half of the derivation is missing.

S1.3.2 states the invariant (stored array = D_v of the logical array), the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, and the reason (a common frame commutes with a pointwise gate), all as at 804-825. It is a single infer step with no method or sub-steps, so I count it as stated (conservative).

The plan reconstructs the form x^T(I-J/9)y and <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1, the terminal labels, the stage transitions, the gate order with central return A⊗F -> B⊗F, the residual of the side edge 2->5 (dimension h-2), the telescoping to Wm-2N, L=Ich, both ratios 100/539 and 101/539, and the binary orthonormal bases (S2.1.1), all as at 856-1110. The binary label field F_2^h for the complex network is only implicit in S2.1.

Matches 1115-1171. The plan states P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources and 0 elsewhere; it gives rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the N exceptional first edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0, and the endpoint difference I_m on every role. The shear frames Phi_M are used in S1.3.5.

Follows 1231-1315. The plan gives the phase frames C_U, weight additivity mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, odd weight giving aI+bX_v or its inverse via Hadamard conjugation, the count s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c with positive deficit, and the 27-coordinate correction C=iZC^{-1}Z giving C^{⊗mk} on k columns.

For the bit network the chain is complete and correct: L_b/N=100/539<1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0, eta_b=339/22587335000000>20*2^-50, log m<20, hence s_b/W_b<m^tau with tau=1-2^-50 (1319-1344). For the complex network the plan has s_c<W_c m and sigma=1-2^-50, but it never states eta_c=73/19906842167500 or derives s_c/W_c<m^sigma; S2.8 only assumes it.

S1.1 states the four elementary O(V) operations correctly. S1.2 states the controlled shift with b^{O(1)} offset preparation and sketches the split-and-swap proof (574-590). It omits the lemma's hypotheses that q is prime and that the coefficient denominators (and numerators of units) are prime to q (557-560). Both are infer steps without sub-steps.

Faithful to 1375-1446. The plan has A=E_1 Pi E_2 by elimination with the topmost row and rightmost pivot, a prime q avoiding denominators and diagonal numerators, lower-triangular updates in descending physical order, and the sequence D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j giving (h+d,d) with one interchange per one of Pi. The requirement that every H_i precede every D_j is only implicit.

Matches 1491-1588. The plan gives the cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, the shear frames with output Phi_{I_m}f_w, i.e. H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows, and the three-update interchange. It has s calls, so F_0=O(1) and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum giving O(e^tau), and the parking-stack schedule at O(V) per node.

Faithful to 1649-1734. The plan has rho=ceil(k log W/(2 log q)) high digits forming a row field q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding below 2R, the base-m split with a_j<m and m^k<me, and binary ranges padded to [q^e] with e=O(u). The unequal-width extension (1740-1762) is not covered, but it is not part of the lemma.

Follows 1849-1940. The plan gives the conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} with the residual basis as the first columns of M, the e=mf slot layout with exactly s_c forward children (inverses via (-i)^f Z C Z), the binary change of basis as a fixed number of row additions (S2.6), and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D with the stated b^D.

Faithful to 2013-2207. The plan gives the eight +-1 steps with cycles (00 01 10),(01 10 11) and displacement at most four, the whole-chunk cyclic shifts with target-independent offsets, guards 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^-K}, the repair of T_0 S_0^{-1} on B by radix sorting, and the top position by a two-bit operation. The family condition A_rect=O(p) is omitted from S2.5's statement.

The plan states the node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows from the first q_0=O(log d) chunks padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, children of volume V/W, and F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e) below d^beta. It also bounds internal costs O(e^lambda) via K<=e^{c/beta} and leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}) (2286-2430). It omits the base-m partition of the remaining D-q_0 chunks and the log(2d) factor absorbed by the strict lambda' (2432-2445).

The statement (D<=d chunks, one common selected bit, Q_p(H z) in O(Vd^{lambda'}) with error <sqrt2 2^-p, exact evaluation with Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) guard bits) matches 2588-2684. S2.9 only asserts the guard width: the depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E (which uses s, not s/W) and the constants E, B, C_0, C_1 from 2457-2560 are absent.

Faithful to 2819-3200. The plan covers the shift by t/2^{v+1} giving the factor y^{rj_0}=-1 with no two-torsion, decimation in frequency, bit-reversed storage giving B_t F_t^- and F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, and the layout L of O(dK) slot moves and O(p/K) chunk exchanges. It also covers rounds as one layer plus J_E, prefix rounds at O(TpdK), and truncation commuting with J_E to give error <sqrt2 ell 2^-p.

Matches 3233-3367. The plan has B_0=2^{4p}, four products with the established multiplier, |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<2^{3p}<B_0/2, centered-residue extraction with the carry in {0,1} cancelling sign extension, the negacyclic wrap, and division by 2^{p+ell} with truncation, all in O(rp log(rp)).

Follows 3414-3495. The plan has F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g) with F^+F^-=I/M, products in the retained LB order since P(LBu,LBv)=LBP(u,v), and error 2delta+eta then 3delta+eta scaled by M to sqrt2 M(3ell+1)2^-p, with the stated cost.

Faithful to 3576-3694 and 3836-3889. The plan has T P_s F_s=P_t F_t S, N=CTD with ||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}<1/2, A=S/2 and B_0=D'J'C with normalizations multiplying to 2^{-2alpha^2}, errors 16p and 4+3p^2/4 below p^2, the two sorts not executed, and the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2, error dp^2 and exposure O(Tpd^2(1+ell^tau)).

S4.3 states eq:source-permutation-cancel with the unit argument RF^+R=F^+ and R commuting with pointwise products (3953-3965). The normalization step F(u*v)=S Fu.Fv giving 1/S^2 is not shown. These are infer steps, so I count them as stated.

Matches 4004-4193. The plan has the fixed exponents and kappa=2^-182, b, p=6b, d, K, T, r, t_i in {r/2,r}, eta=1/(4d) primes with more than d per interval and disjoint intervals, S/T>(1-1/(2d))^d>1/2, alpha^4 theta_i>3db>=p, the n^{o(1)} search, and no wraparound with c_j<2^{3b}.

S4.7.2 states the twist x_d -> zeta y with the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T, as at 4303-4342. The computed procedure with approximate twist arrays (errors below 4 units each, 4374-4413) is not described.

The source transform (A-tilde, computed chirp, B_0-tilde, 2^gamma) with counterpart RF_s and its conjugate, and the six steps with the two scales by S and 2^{2b+4}S, match 4454-4541. The plan never states that the digits are entered as a_j 2^{-b-2} (4495-4498). That scaling is what the factor 2^{2b+4} undoes, and it appears only implicitly as 'norm below 1/4' in S4.9.4.

Matches the table at 4815-4835, the margins g_1..g_7 with minimum g_2=2^-181=2kappa (4837-4854), the layout cost O(pK^{tau-1}), packed products at O(Tp log(rp)) without self-call, o(V) setup and exceptional sorting, log powers absorbed by p^kappa, and the schoolbook cutoff (4857-4995).

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route. Two recursive network procedures (S1 interchange, S2 butterfly layer) feed the synthetic transforms and the convolution (S3), then resampling/chirp/CRT/multiplication with exact recovery (S4), then the normalized cost table (S5). The bit-network branch S1.3 is reconstructed in full, from network, frames, labels, ranks and budget to the endpoint identity, shear factorization and recurrence. The plan thins out on the complex side: the complex scalar network itself, eta_c and s_c/W_c<m^sigma, the base-m piece decomposition of the layer recurrence, and the guard-width depth recurrence are asserted rather than shown. The input digit scale 2^{-b-2} is left implicit.

steps.note: S1.3.1 gives banks X_a,Y_a indexed by triples of [100] and the three-stage network sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every scratch wire. S1.3.3.6 gives N=v^3 with v=C(100,3), and m is the dimension of (Q^h)^{⊗3}=h^3 (stated only implicitly through F).

S1.3.2 states one invertible frame per gate, D_v D_u^{-1} per edge, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} with route operator eps_w D_sink D_source^{-1}, and the commutation reason (812). This matches 804-825.

The plan uses nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} built from triple indicators, with neighbouring triple lines orthogonal. Every edge joins comparable labels, and the only decrease is the central edge 3->4, removing P⊗F⊗Q of dimension h (997-1000, 1061).
S1.3.3.7.1 has P_V-P_U of rank dim V-dim U for nested labels. S1.3.3.7.2 has the N exceptional first edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one where the dimension change is zero (1158-1165).
The plan gives the sum of absolute changes Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich (S1.3.3.5, S1.3.3.5.4) and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b after adding the N source ranks (S1.3.3.7.3), as at 1003-1006 and 1151.
S1.3.3.6 gives L_b/N=100/539<1/2 and S2.1.4 gives L_c/N=101/539. The deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 give s<Wm in both networks (1105-1110, 1167, 1260).
S1.3.3.7.4 derives M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m for X_a). S1.3.5 turns it into Phi_{I_m}, i.e. H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows (1522-1533).
S1.3.4 gives A=E_1 Pi E_2 and exactly a interchanges plus O(V), with one interchange per one of Pi (S1.3.4.4). S1.3.7.1 gives exactly s recursive calls per node, each on volume V/W (1543-1544).
S1.3.7 gives children of volume V/W and F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), hence F_k=O(e^tau). S1.3.3.8 derives s_b/W_b<m^tau with tau=1-2^-50 from eta_b>20*2^-50 and log m<20 (1331-1341, 1550-1557).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs all nine steps of the central saving for the bit network. In order these are: the h=100 triple network with its signed bank exchange and restored scratch, frames commuting with pointwise gates, nested nondegenerate labels whose only loss is h on each central 3->4 edge, rank equal to dimension change plus N rank-one source edges, the budget Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b, L/N=100/539 and 101/539 below 1/2, the endpoint identity I_m giving H<-H+D, edge shears costing exactly their rank in interchanges, and the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with tau=1-2^-50. Only the complex-network analogue of the exponent bound (eta_c) is left implicit.
